items.title: Workday (WDAY) Deepens Its AI Push Through Two New Partnerships
items.summary: Workday (NasdaqGS:WDAY) has partnered with The Josh Bersin Company to integrate its Galileo AI-based HR advisory agent into Workday tools. The firm also announced a collaboration with Zuora to connect Workday finance applications with Zuora's AI and usage-based pricing capabilities. Both partnerships aim to expand Workday's AI-driven workforce planning and billing features for large enterprises.
